form.label: LogScrub — Interactive Scrubber
form.description: Paste any text below, choose your options, and click Scrub to see the sanitized output and findings.

input.label: Text to Scrub
input.default: Paste your log line, JSON payload, or any text here. Example: user john.doe@example.com logged in from 192.168.1.55 using card 4111-1111-1111-1111
input.initialValue: Paste your log line, JSON payload, or any text here. Example: user john.doe@example.com logged in from 192.168.1.55 using card 4111-1111-1111-1111

search.query: | makeresults | eval _raw="$tok_input$" | sanitize standard="$tok_standard$" mask_style="$tok_mask_style$" report_findings=true | table _raw, _raw_findings, _raw_finding_count | rename _raw AS "Scrubbed Text", _raw_findings AS "Findings", _raw_finding_count AS "Finding Count"

| makeresults | eval _raw="$tok_input$" | sanitize standard="$tok_standard$" mask_style="$tok_mask_style$" report_findings=true | eval findings_list=split(_raw_findings, ",") | mvexpand findings_list | eval findings_list=trim(findings_list) | where isnotnull(findings_list) AND findings_list!="" | stats count AS occurrences BY findings_list | rename findings_list AS "Pattern Matched", occurrences AS "Count" | sort - Count
| makeresults | eval _raw="$tok_input$" | table _raw | rename _raw AS "Original Text"
